notes:
The fake backend is a pure Python reimplementation of fancy/SimpleReacher-v0 (SimpleReacherEnv and its two base classes) with the registered n_links=2 and the 200-step TimeLimit; it returns the full 9-value observation for n_links=2 (3*n_links+3), not a reduced array. It was not compared with the upstream environment because fancy_gym, gymnasium, numpy and matplotlib are not importable in the gate; the sim backend path gymnasium.make('fancy/SimpleReacher-v0') was not run. The fake uses Python random.Random and lists, upstream uses numpy's generator and float32 arrays; the self-collision test only checks joint limits, not segment intersections; no rendering, no PassiveEnvChecker and no movement-primitive wrapper. No hardware was attached and no hardware run is claimed. The package is model-authored and unreviewed. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed used by the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer/numeric inputs (ticks, action.values, and seed twice); there were no G4 warnings and no catalogue extension ids.
